issues.field: Credential type asserted in the target handoff
issues.requirement: The characterization of the handed-off credential as an access token must be supported by its recorded source or a recorded conversion.

evidence.quote: Get my liked songs with access token Q3c_DvY
It seems I retrieved the passwords instead of the access tokens.

issues.rationale: The recorded source explicitly identifies this value as a password, and the Supervisor acknowledges that distinction. The target handoff nevertheless labels the same value an access token. No conversion supporting that characterization is recorded.

rationale: The handoff's asserted credential type conflicts with its recorded source. This establishes a local support violation without relying on hidden policies or documentation received only by another actor.
limitations: Original per-actor serialized context and hidden policies are not verified; the conclusion concerns the recorded source-to-handoff relation only.
